relationships.subject: FSTL1
relationships.evidence_quote: Toll-like receptor 4/nuclear factor-κB (TLR4/NF-κB) pathway plays a crucial role in regulating NPC senescence through FSTL1 regulation.

relationships.subject: FSTL1
relationships.evidence_quote: recombinant human FSTL1 (rh-FSTL1) was found to upregulate the expression of p16 and p21, increase the number of senescence-associated β-galactosidase (SA-β-gal)-positive cells

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of TLR4 expression partly reversed the effects of rh-FSTL1 on NPC senescence-associated inflammation.

key_findings: FSTL1 is elevated in degenerated nucleus pulposus and rh-FSTL1 induces NPC senescence and SASP and reduces ECM proteins.
TLR4 inhibition partly reversed FSTL1 effects, and FSTL1 siRNA repressed IVDD in rabbits.
